questions.history: On the merge concatenate the converter’s encoded 7 (scale 0) and 12.30. Present only the latter as a heap ByteBuffer slice, and compare with a standalone copy of those same remaining bytes.
questions.prediction: Both views should decode to 12.30 if fromBytes honors the active view. The landed use of value.array() predicts the slice may instead decode the preceding 7.

questions.refutation: The standalone value is 12.30 while the sliced value is 7, differs in scale, or throws.
